title: Qualified architecture snapshot generation
description: Compose selected model capture, interpretation, qualified projection and bounded derived-output publication for a customer request. Project model is accountable; command admission remains with Operations.

operations.name: generate_architecture_snapshot
operations.purpose: Prepare and publish a qualified selected snapshot.
inputs: Project/profile, immutable input selection, output path, expected output identity and replacement authority.
preconditions: Requested project/output scope is explicit; generation or recovery requires its applicable write authority.
outputs: Published output identity, captured-source provenance and actual committed/uncommitted/recovery-required outcome.
behavior: Compose MOD-001 capture and MOD-003 interpretation before MOD-004 projection and preparation.
Reject invalid required input and unsupported profiles; retain optional gaps and proposed/observed qualifications.
Publish only complete prepared output after exact ownership and expected-current checks.

failure_behavior.condition: Input interpretation, output ownership, dependency compatibility or expected-state binding cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return a scoped failure or recovery requirement without a complete result or unrelated writes.

operations.name: check_architecture_snapshot
operations.purpose: Compare declared source/tool inputs and selected output without writes.
inputs: The same selection and tool identity plus existing output identity.
preconditions: Requested project/output scope is explicit; generation or recovery requires its applicable write authority.
outputs: Current, stale, invalid or unavailable comparison with its exact scope; no generation or approval claim.
behavior: Read identified content and manifests without taking a write action or repairing output.
Do not treat a matching source revision alone as current when dirty content or tool/resource versions differ.

failure_behavior.condition: Input interpretation, output ownership, dependency compatibility or expected-state binding cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return a scoped failure or recovery requirement without a complete result or unrelated writes.

operations.name: recover_architecture_snapshot
operations.purpose: Reconcile an exact interrupted derived-output operation under explicit authority.
inputs: Owned output, retained candidate/previous entry identities, operation ownership and requested bounded disposition.
preconditions: Requested project/output scope is explicit; generation or recovery requires its applicable write authority.
outputs: Actual committed, uncommitted or unresolved output state, retained versions and remaining recovery requirement.
behavior: Inspect entry and retained manifests before acting; do not blindly replay a generation request.
Never remove a writer lock based only on age or a reused process ID. Require reliable owner-death/exclusion and exact expected-state evidence or stop.

failure_behavior.condition: Input interpretation, output ownership, dependency compatibility or expected-state binding cannot be established.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return a scoped failure or recovery requirement without a complete result or unrelated writes.

consistency_rules: Every successful result binds project/profile, exact captured input, generator/renderer and complete output identity; profile conformance is not engineering approval.
Only the selected owned output may change. Input definitions, unrelated content, operational history and external publication are excluded.
The entry-file switch is the output commit point. Failed preparation preserves old output; failed reporting after commitment reports committed state and does not imply rollback.
compatibility_rules: This proposed browser-v1 contract does not change Baseline-specific IF-007 or operational v3/v4 recording. No callable implementation or public command is claimed by this model.
Initial compatibility is the exact profile/runtime/platform/reader matrix shipped with a qualified candidate. Unknown versions, operations or outcome values reject rather than fallback.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
